payload.acceptance_criteria:

The && and || rule does not refuse a pipeline whose first command is a read-only query: git status, git log, git diff, git rev-parse, ls, grep or cat.
Every refused command from the 2026-11-19 investigation is a test case. The 5 true positives stay refused.
The refusal advice gives the Code Mode REPL form: cut the output in JavaScript, so .exitCode stays the command's status.
